dialogues.speaker: Riqueti
dialogues.text: Ah. Are you concerned about it as well?

dialogues.speaker: Riqueti
dialogues.text: Good. Then you've got a better nose for danger than many people here in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Riqueti
dialogues.text: There is no point discussing the veracity of such a thing, because before a crisis comes, no one can truly use accurate evidence to convince another.

dialogues.speaker: Riqueti
dialogues.text: But if we don't consider it at all... Some might call it optimism. Others would call it folly.
